title: Come, Holy Ghost, in Might
description: Come, Holy Ghost, in Might in Tonic Solfa to AYLESBURY, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns from the Morningland (Paisley, 1911), headed “Spirit, Blest”.
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Short Metre (6.6.8.6), and this page sets them to AYLESBURY; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Come, Ho-ly Ghost, in might, And make our weak-ness strong; Re-new our val-our in the fight A-gainst the power of wrong.

lines: Renew our valour in the fight
The zeal our lives have lost,
And on our fainting spirits pour
Our minds and hearts to cheer,
And pierce the darkness of our night
That stooped to earth from heaven above,
Our praise shall rise to Thee;
And to the Father and the Son,

source: John Brownlie, Hymns from the Morningland (1911)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns from the Morningland; set to AYLESBURY by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
